description: VR IMU breakout board with CEVA/Bosch BNO086 (BNO08X family), Qwiic connector

ports.label: 3V3 / GND (Qwiic)
ports.note: VDD deve energizar antes ou junto com VDDIO

ports.label: I²C 0x4A/0x4B (Qwiic)
ports.note: selecionado por PS1/PS0 = 00 no reset; não suporta polling, exige a linha H_INTN

ports.label: UART (RVC ou SHTP)
ports.note: RVC (PS=01, 115200) é o modo pensado para robôs terrestres e exige cristal externo

ports.label: H_INTN
ports.note: obrigatório em I²C; o host deve responder em 1/10 do período do sensor mais rápido

specs.sensors: 9-axis: triaxial 12-bit accelerometer, triaxial 16-bit gyroscope, triaxial geomagnetic sensor, plus 32-bit Cortex-M0+ running CEVA SH-2 sensor fusion

supply-voltage.note: VDD must be powered before or at the same time as VDDIO; Qwiic bus is 3.3 V

current.note: BNO086 table, VDDIO 3 V + VDD 3.3 V, sum of both rails; idle 0.047 mA (VDDIO) + 0.01 mA (VDD)

accuracy.note: degrees; heading drift in degrees per minute; datasheet notes that in practice the rotation vector is typically accurate to 5 degrees and the geomagnetic one to 10 degrees

max-output-rate.note: not all sensors can run at their maximum rate simultaneously

communications.protocol-selection: pins PS1/PS0 sampled at reset: 00 = I2C, 01 = UART-RVC, 10 = UART-SHTP, 11 = SPI

i2c.mode: slave, standard 100 kbit/s and fast 400 kbit/s
i2c.address-selection: SA0 pin sets the lowest address bit
i2c.pull-ups: 2k to 4k ohm on SCL and SDA
i2c.note: the BNO086 does not support polling over I2C, the host must use the H_INTN interrupt line

spi.mode: 4-wire slave, SPI mode 3 (CPOL = 1, CPHA = 1), MSB first
spi.note: PS0 becomes the WAKE signal after reset

uart-rvc.description: simplified one-way mode designed for ground roving robots: streams heading and acceleration continuously
uart-rvc.packet: 19 bytes: header 0xAAAA + index + yaw/pitch/roll (0.01 deg units) + x/y/z acceleration (mg) + motion intent + motion request + reserved + checksum
uart-rvc.note: requires the external crystal or clock, not the internal oscillator

communications.data-protocol: SHTP (Sensor Hub Transport Protocol) over I2C, SPI and UART-SHTP

control-pins.name: H_INTN
control-pins.description: interrupt to host, active low; host should respond within 1/10 of the fastest sensor period

control-pins.name: BOOTN
control-pins.description: low at reset enters bootloader (firmware update); pull high through 10k

control-pins.name: PS0/WAKE
control-pins.description: protocol select 0, doubles as wake signal in SPI mode

control-pins.name: SA0
control-pins.description: I2C address low bit / SPI data in

communications.board-connector: Qwiic (JST-SH 4 pin, 3.3 V I2C) plus broken-out header pins
